text:
Stop asking ChatGPT to "write a blog post."

You get boring, generic answers because your prompt is missing 3 basic details.

How to fix it:
• Give it a role: "Act as a senior marketer."
• Give it a target: "Write a 300-word email for busy moms."
• Give it a rule: "Use plain English and zero buzzwords."

The bottom line:
Clear rules turn lazy AI responses into perfect drafts in seconds.

What is your favorite rule to give AI?
